newsitem.title: UK: UK consumer watchdog calls for mortgage refrm.
newsitem.headline: UK consumer watchdog calls for mortgage refrm.

text.p: Britain's official consumer watchdog on Wednesday called for the government to clear what it termed "the mortgage minefield", saying that lenders were failing to provide crucial help and advice to borrowers. As a result, the National Consumer Council said, home-buyers are paying for unsuitable mortgages and footing the bill for hidden extras.

The NCC was responding to a consultation by the Council of Mortgage Lenders and said it was urging the government to rule that all lenders must give home buyers "best advice" wisely and all must join a complaints body.
